description: This Java class implements a batch job writer for journal entry aggregation summaries within the Apache Fineract project. It acts as a Spring Batch ItemWriter and StepExecutionListener, managing the writing of batch data and tracking step execution context.

classes.name: JournalEntryAggregationJobWriter
classes.description: A Spring Batch ItemWriter and StepExecutionListener that processes journal entry aggregation summaries and persists them using the associated service.

methods.name: beforeStep
methods.description: Initializes the stepExecution context before the batch step begins.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Transforms batch items by assigning job execution ID and passes them to the writer service for batch insertion.
